output.subject: We've received your complaint about collection calls
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us, and congratulations on your new baby. We have received your complaint, and a member of our team has read it carefully.

You told us you know you are behind on your card payments and are working to catch up. You said you are receiving around eight calls a day, including one as late as 9:40pm and one as early as 7am on a Sunday morning. You explained that on 9/14 you told the person you spoke with that you get paid on the 15th and would pay then. You also said you called us again on 9/22 but nothing changed. You asked us to please stop calling so often.

We're sorry for the stress this has caused, especially while you are caring for a newborn.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you for taking the time to tell us about this.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer selected 'Loan' as the topic, but the complaint is about a card account; confirm which account the calls relate to.
Calls appear to be ongoing; decide whether contact frequency or timing should be addressed before the 10-day response.
Verify call logs for frequency and times, including the reported 9:40pm and 7am Sunday calls.
Check records of the 9/14 and 9/22 calls and whether a promise to pay on the 15th was noted.
Customer has a newborn and is behind on payments; consider whether financial difficulty or vulnerability support applies.
Clarify which month's 15th the customer meant, as the 9/15 date has passed relative to the 9/22 call.
